scheme_name: Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards (National Level)
description:
The Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards is a national-level initiative launched by the Government of India to promote and recognize musical talent across the country. 

The festival was officially launched on March 15, 2022. 

It aims to celebrate the rich diversity of Indian music and provide a platform for artists from various genres and backgrounds. 

The primary objective of the Tanariri Music Awards is to encourage young and emerging musicians. 

The festival seeks to promote cultural heritage through music and foster a sense of unity among diverse communities. 

One of the measurable targets of the festival is to award at least 100 artists annually. 

The festival also aims to provide financial assistance to deserving artists to support their musical endeavors. 

The total prize money allocated for the awards is ₹50 lakh annually. 

This amount is distributed across various categories including Best New Artist Best Music Video and Best Album. 

Each winner in the major categories receives a cash prize of ₹5 lakh. 

Additionally winners in subcategories receive prizes ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹3 lakh. 

The festival is open to musicians from all age groups. 

There are no specific age limits for participation. 

However participants must demonstrate a significant level of skill and creativity in their musical performances. 

Eligibility criteria include being a resident of India and having at least one published musical work. 

Artists must submit their entries through the official website of the festival. 

The application process involves filling out an online form and uploading a sample of their work. 

Required documents include a government-issued ID proof and a brief biography of the artist. 

The festival also encourages collaborations between artists from different regions. 

This is aimed at promoting cross-cultural exchanges and enhancing the richness of Indian music. 

The festival is held annually with the next edition scheduled for March 2023. 

The awards ceremony is typically held in the first week of March. 

The disbursement of prize money occurs immediately after the announcement of winners. 

The festival is organized by the Ministry of Culture in collaboration with various state governments. 

The National School of Music is one of the key implementing agencies for the festival. 

Contact details for inquiries can be found on the official website of the Ministry of Culture. 

The festival also includes workshops and masterclasses conducted by renowned musicians. 

These sessions are designed to provide aspiring artists with valuable insights into the music industry. 

The festival aims to attract a diverse audience including music enthusiasts and industry professionals. 

It is expected to draw participation from over 5000 artists across the country. 

The festival also features performances by established artists to inspire the younger generation. 

Social media campaigns are used to promote the festival and engage with a wider audience. 

The festival has received positive feedback from participants and audiences alike. 

It has been praised for its efforts to uplift and support local talent. 

The festival also aims to create a sustainable model for promoting music in India. 

It seeks to establish partnerships with music labels and production houses. 

These partnerships are intended to provide further opportunities for emerging artists. 

The festival emphasizes the importance of preserving traditional music forms. 

It includes categories specifically for folk and classical music. 

The festival also recognizes contributions to music education and community engagement. 

Awards are given for initiatives that promote music in schools and local communities. 

The festival is supported by various sponsors including music equipment brands and educational institutions. 

This support helps enhance the overall experience for participants and attendees. 

The festival also aims to leverage technology for wider reach and engagement. 

Virtual participation options are available for artists unable to attend in person. 

The festival has a dedicated team for managing logistics and operations. 

This team ensures that the event runs smoothly and efficiently. 

The festival's impact is measured through participant feedback and audience engagement metrics. 

It aims to increase its reach by 20 percent each year. 

The festival also collaborates with media partners for extensive coverage. 

This helps in promoting the artists and their work to a larger audience. 

The Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards is a significant step towards recognizing and nurturing musical talent in India. 

It reflects the government's commitment to promoting arts and culture. 

The festival serves as a beacon of hope for aspiring musicians across the nation. 

By providing a platform for recognition and support it helps in the overall growth of the music industry. 

The festival is expected to evolve and expand in the coming years. 

It aims to incorporate more categories and increase the prize money. 

The festival's long-term vision includes establishing a national music academy. 

This academy would focus on training and mentoring young musicians. 

The Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards is a landmark initiative in the Indian cultural landscape. 

It embodies the spirit of creativity and collaboration in the music community. 

Through this festival the government aims to create a vibrant ecosystem for music in India. 

The festival is not just an awards ceremony but a celebration of the power of music. 

It encourages artists to express themselves and share their stories through their art. 

The festival is a testament to the rich musical heritage of India. 

It aims to inspire future generations to pursue their passion for music. 

The Tanariri Music Awards Festival and Awards is set to leave a lasting legacy in the Indian music scene.
